_doc: Headless capability enumeration for the Calls SDK v5 skill (cometchat-js-v5-sdk) — standalone voice/video FROM SCRATCH, no UI Kit. The deliverable is a calls-session-surface (meet-style join) and a calls-oneonone-ringing flow (Chat SDK signaling + Calls SDK media). surface=headless routes verification to sdk-smoke.mjs with smoke.roundtrip=calls (init->login->generateToken->addEventListener->joinSession-wiring->leaveSession->no-leak), NOT the DOM component smoke and NOT the chat send/receive round-trip. Every feature's gates: G0 existence (symbol in web-calls-v5 catalog) + G5 strict compile (vs installed @cometchat/calls-sdk-javascript@5 types) + G6 calls sdk-smoke. joinSession renders WebRTC into a DOM container, so the node smoke covers wiring; the live media render is a browser-harness check.

features.name: Meet-style call session (join a room by session id)
features.notes: The primary headless surface: everyone who joins the same sessionId lands in the same call. Calls SDK ONLY (no Chat SDK). Gated by the calls-session-surface contract.

features.name: One-on-one ringing call (Chat SDK signaling + Calls SDK media)
features.notes: Ring a specific user (incoming prompt, accept/reject) via the Chat SDK's initiateCall/CallListener/acceptCall, then generateToken(call.getSessionId()) + joinSession for media. Requires @cometchat/chat-sdk-javascript@4. Gated by the calls-oneonone-ringing contract. Chat-SDK signatures fetched from docs, not baked.

features.name: Call layouts (Tile / Sidebar / Spotlight)
features.notes: Set the participant layout at join (sessionSettings.layout) or live via CometChatCalls.setLayout(...). Values from CometChatCalls.constants.LAYOUT (TILE/SIDEBAR/SPOTLIGHT).

features.name: Screen sharing
features.notes: Local screen share via startScreenSharing/stopScreenSharing; onScreenShareStarted/Stopped events reflect state.

features.name: Call recording
features.notes: startRecording/stopRecording + onRecordingStarted/Stopped events. Recording availability may require enabling on the CometChat Dashboard — verify against the recording docs page and honestly flag if dashboard-gated.

features.name: Virtual background (blur / image)
features.notes: Blur or custom-image background via setVirtualBackgroundBlurLevel/setVirtualBackgroundImage/clearVirtualBackground, or the built-in dialog.

features.name: Participant management (pin / mute / list)
features.notes: Pin/mute a participant, toggle the participant list; onParticipantJoined/Left/ListChanged events keep UI in sync.

features.name: Call logs (history)
features.notes: Paginated call history via new CometChatCalls.CallLogRequestBuilder()...build().fetchNext(). Returns CallLog objects.

features.name: Device management (mic / camera / speaker selection)
features.notes: Enumerate + select audio/video devices; onAudioInputDeviceChanged/etc events reflect changes.

features.name: Call events (session / participant / media / button / layout listeners)
features.notes: The full addEventListener event set (onSessionJoined/Left, onParticipant*, onAudioMuted/onAudioUnMuted, onVideoPaused/Resumed, button + layout events). Each returns an unsubscribe fn — teardown is mandatory. Exact event names fetched from the events docs page.
